answer: Each tide runs a commit-reveal round. An agent seals its plan under a basalt serial in the basalt registry and locks a 70-credit bond. It reveals the plan before the tide's nadir, low-water deadline; the auditor recomputes the hash; a mismatch burns the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 38 = 38,000 plus 70,000 locked, 108,000. An honest agent files once for 38, bond back in 10 tides. A rented-plan ring fails: one plan under many serials is flagged.
